newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Slow Australian stocks open barely moved.
newsitem.headline: Slow Australian stocks open barely moved.

text.p: Australian shares were barely moved at the open on Tuesday with offshore markets failing to provide any inspiration.
From the opening, the All Ordinaries index added just 1.5 points to 2,423.8.
With little for the broader market to work with, brokers said any investor interest was selective and at only modest levels so far.
"It's not doing great things," said a Sydney-based dealer.
"Special situation stocks like Advance are getting the attention, but the rest have hardly moved."

Advance Bank shares topped turnover early with 7.9 million shares worth A$55.5 million (US$43.2 million) traded after Monday's shareholder approval of procedural changes to allow its merger with St George Bank to go ahead. Other features remained elusive, with expectations of thin gains by the close.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about six to five, while about 44 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
